name: Anam Tbung
summary: A Jrai feast dish of rice flour cooked with pork offal, beef offal, or meat, made for a wedding, a funeral, a death anniversary, or a new house.
origin: Siu Phĩu’s account on the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism site separates Anam Tbung from everyday cassava-leaf soup. It is rice flour, usually with offal or meat, and it is not a weekday bowl.
howToEat: Cook it from rice flour with pork offal, beef offal, or meat.
Eat it at a funeral, a wedding, a death anniversary, or a new house.
where: Jrai kitchens. The cook who describes it lives in buôn Ama Hyai, Krông Pa.
seoTitle: Anam Tbung — Jrai rice flour for a feast
seoDescription: Anam Tbung is Jrai rice flour with offal or meat, cooked for a funeral, a wedding, a death anniversary, or a new house.
